harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: pair classes without a cell of the dependency table (kind raw, the floor of producer -> consumer), each request with its positive control (control stale: the producer's word behind the consumer and its checksum, expected not right in every thread-launch): F2FP.PACK -> IMAD r1 (IMAD.SHL.U32 and IMAD), MOV / IADD / IMAD.WIDE / IADD3 / LOP3 / SHF -> the register-register IADD.64 (the low and the high word of the first and of the second operand pair), IADD.64 -> the low register of a global store's address pair, SEL -> PRMT r3, IADD3 -> I2FP r1, PRMT / F2FP.PACK / SHF -> SEL r1, IADD3 -> SHF r1, SEL -> MOV r1, IADD -> LEA r1, IMAD.WIDE -> IMAD r2, UMOV -> MOV u1; six grids; distances 1 ... 12, 15, 26, 45 - on a Workstation Edition card, beside a sustained load at the 400-W limit

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
conditions.load: the shipped attention kernel sparse_mla_prefill_v41 (sha256 c896234b...) in its timing loop, a second process on the same card

provenance.dep_table_commit: f62e790 tools/stallfloor/probe.py 24, second part: the hold of each register of the accumulator quad; the Workstation co

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
